# DevExpress Reporting Skills

AI agent skills for [DevExpress Reporting](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/reporting/) - XtraReports runtime APIs and platform-specific integration for web and desktop .NET applications.

All skills target DevExpress Reporting v26.1.

## Skills

| Skill | Covers | Docs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [devexpress-reporting-core](devexpress-reporting-core/) | Platform-neutral XtraReports runtime API: report creation, bands/controls, data binding, expressions, export | [SKILL.md](devexpress-reporting-core/SKILL.md) |
| [devexpress-reporting-angular](devexpress-reporting-angular/) | Angular integration: Web Document Viewer and Report Designer setup/customization | [SKILL.md](devexpress-reporting-angular/SKILL.md) |
| [devexpress-reporting-aspnetcore](devexpress-reporting-aspnetcore/) | ASP.NET Core integration: services, viewer/designer wiring, report storage, export/print | [SKILL.md](devexpress-reporting-aspnetcore/SKILL.md) |
| [devexpress-reporting-blazor](devexpress-reporting-blazor/) | Blazor integration: viewer/designer configuration, backend services, report binding | [SKILL.md](devexpress-reporting-blazor/SKILL.md) |
| [devexpress-reporting-winforms](devexpress-reporting-winforms/) | WinForms integration: print preview, End-User Designer, toolbar/toolbox customization | [SKILL.md](devexpress-reporting-winforms/SKILL.md) |
| [devexpress-reporting-wpf](devexpress-reporting-wpf/) | WPF integration: preview, designer, print/export, MVVM-aligned patterns | [SKILL.md](devexpress-reporting-wpf/SKILL.md) |

## Layout

Each skill folder contains:

- `SKILL.md` - activators, constraints, and navigation guidance
- `references/` - scenario-focused implementation guides
- `examples/` - runnable quickstart/sample project files
